query: Equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr exhibits 8–16% room-temperature tensile ductility in the cast state and a yield strength of 163–530 MPa at 1000 °C at strain rates of 10−4–10−2 s−1, but inadequate oxygen resistance prevents most practical high-temperature applications. Earlier oxidation-protection research prevented pesting in a related, non-equiatomic Hf–Nb–Ta–Ti–Zr alloy during a 5 h exposure to air at 800 °C, but that result does not establish protection for equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr; related studies on other refractory alloys likewise did not evaluate this composition. With preservation of useful room- and high-temperature mechanical performance as a design constraint, what single intervention could improve the oxygen resistance of equiatomic cast HfNbTaTiZr? Formulate one hypothesis identifying the intervention and mechanism, predicting the outcome relative to untreated material, defining the applicable temperature, atmosphere, exposure-time, and loading boundaries, citing supporting evidence from the prior studies, and specifying a controlled experiment and result that would falsify the hypothesis.

generation.hypothesis: Aluminum oxide (Al2O3) coating can improve the oxygen resistance of equiatomic cast HfNbTaTiZr.
generation.intervention: Application of an aluminum oxide (Al2O3) coating
generation.conditions: Temperature: up to 1000 °C, Atmosphere: air, Exposure time: up to 100 hours, Loading: tensile stress up to 500 MPa
generation.structural_mediator: Formation of a dense and adherent Al2O3 layer on the surface of HfNbTaTiZr
generation.mechanism: The Al2O3 coating acts as a barrier to oxygen diffusion, preventing the formation of a thick oxide layer and reducing the rate of oxidation
generation.predicted_outcome: Improved oxygen resistance, with a reduction in oxidation rate and an increase in the time to onset of pesting, while maintaining useful room- and high-temperature mechanical performance
generation.boundary: Temperature: 1000 °C, Atmosphere: air, Exposure time: 100 hours, Loading: 500 MPa
generation.uncertainty: The effectiveness of the Al2O3 coating in improving oxygen resistance may depend on the coating thickness, microstructure, and adherence to the substrate, which can be affected by the coating process and the surface preparation of the HfNbTaTiZr alloy

falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the Al2O3-coated HfNbTaTiZr exhibits no significant improvement in oxygen resistance, as measured by oxidation rate and time to onset of pesting, and/or a degradation in mechanical properties, compared to the untreated material, then the hypothesis is falsified
